note: Hugging Face model census behind the SdpaBackward HF cases (plan §3.6). Sources: the Hugging Face Hub API rankings sort=likes (top 2,000), sort=downloads (top 2,000) and sort=trending (top 1,000), fetched 2026-11-09: 3,879 distinct models, 3,175 with an architecture config (619 through a quantized repo's base_model), 4,699 attention sites from 2,712 models. A geometry is one real attention call (Hq, Hkv, Dqk, Dv, mask, bias, scale) with the lengths its models use; pop = log2(1 + n_models) + 3 (best rank <= 100) or 1.5 (<= 500). Each case is one variant of a geometry: R real length, one KV group; T tile tails at the real head dims; F real head counts; P packed QKV; V interleaved V (GPT-NeoX/BLOOM); H BHSD; D fp16; M Sq != Skv and windows past W; B batch > 1; X the model's bias forms; U a U(-1, 1) twin of a long case. Long cases draw Q and K from U(-3, 3). census_id is the case id of the census run. sdpa_bwd_plan.py reads this file; nobody edits it by hand.
